keyboardProtocol.finding: press awaits down ACK, then its delay, then up. Separate down/up have independent channel requests and progress controllers. In-process dispatch uses separate setImmediate callbacks; Chromium send writes each request before waiting for its own response id. Browser-side input/render queues can still delay or reorder delivery; actual DOM timing remains the gate.
